policy: Returns are accepted within 14 days when the product is unused and the original packaging is undamaged. Opened or visibly used products are not eligible unless defective.
customer_claim: I tested the monitor for one evening, but the colors looked warmer than expected. The item works and all accessories are included. I want a full refund.
merchant_response: The retail box arrived torn, the protective seal was removed, and the stand shows handling marks. The device activation log shows six hours of use.
evidence_summary: Courier record: parcel delivered without reported damage. Merchant photos: torn box corner, removed seal, fingerprints on stand. Customer confirms the monitor was tested.
